clinic.name: Smile Care Dental Clinic
clinic.legalName: Smile Care Dental Clinic Pvt. Ltd.
clinic.aboutShort: A patient-first dental clinic in the heart of Bandra, combining modern technology with gentle, personalized care.
clinic.aboutLong: Founded in 2009, Smile Care Dental Clinic has been serving the Bandra community for over 15 years with a commitment to painless, high-quality dental care.

doctors.name: Dr. Anjali Mehta
doctors.bio: Dr. Anjali Mehta has been transforming smiles in Bandra for over 16 years, specializing in invisible aligners and smile makeovers.

doctors.name: Dr. Rohan Shah
doctors.bio: Dr. Rohan Shah is a specialist in single-sitting implants and full-mouth rehabilitation.

services.name: Root Canal Treatment
services.shortDescription: Painless, single-sitting root canal therapy using rotary endodontics.
services.longDescription: Our root canal treatments use advanced rotary endodontic technology to ensure a virtually painless experience.

services.name: Dental Implants
services.shortDescription: Permanent tooth replacement with titanium implants.
services.longDescription: Dental implants offer a long-term, natural-looking solution for missing teeth.

services.name: Braces & Invisible Aligners
services.shortDescription: Metal braces, ceramic braces, and clear aligners for all ages.
services.longDescription: We design a treatment plan tailored to your smile goals and lifestyle.

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.shortDescription: In-clinic laser whitening for a brighter smile in one visit.
services.longDescription: Our laser whitening treatment can lighten your teeth by several shades in under an hour.
